decisions.reason: The white-label test pressing series cost little to launch, builds on the firm's collector-focused vinyl offer and was only introduced in 2024, so management can still attribute any weak results to start-up effects and will stay committed to it, although limited-edition runs can quietly end.

The German new wave compilation series is an in-house label commitment that sits close to the core catalog, and having announced a series, management will justify the curation and licensing already invested by continuing to release further volumes.
